messages:
tess: FYI customer FastLane just opened a P1 — they saw a spike of 5xxs and p99s during last night's canary. Need alignment on rollback/milestone commitments :warning:

ev an: Seen the alert. Looks correlated with canary that shipped the perf routing change (PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/4521). I can revert the routing change as an emergency rollback if we agree. :eyes:

mohit: Can confirm traces show queue wait increases on pool-3 when concurrent KV-cache warmups hit. We should consider disabling the new cpu-bound routing heuristic for canaries until we have throttling.

jen (CS): FastLane reports 12% of requests failing for paying customers. They're asking for ETA on fix and whether we'll honor SLA credits if this persists. They want a mitigation timeline.

lauren: Who's owning the rollback? I can take the rollback run once evan posts the command. Need code-owner approval for the change out of canary though — is that a manual PR revert or deploy rollback?

infra-bot: deploy: canary-rollout/infra-routing v2 -> rollback queued by evan at 2026-03-17T02:14:10Z (staging verified).

tev an: Plan proposal: 1) Immediate: revert routing heuristic in canary (evan) — target +15m. 2) Short term: pin FastLane traffic to dedicated fallback model variant (mohit) — +45m. 3) Medium: throttle KV-cache populates during warmup and add circuit-breaker (lauren) — +8h. 4) Postmortem & SLA calc (jen + eng-sre) — +24h. OK?

mohit: I can pin FastLane to fallback variant by editing the routing rule: `routes/fastlane -> model-variant:fallback-v1`. Will do now and report back.

lauren: I can implement the canary revert PR and request a quick review. Ping me the PR URL once created. If infra-bot shows rollback queued, happy to own validation.

jen (CS): Please keep me posted on ETA. FastLane needs a message by EOD saying we have a mitigation plan. If recovery >2h they will expect an SLA credit estimate.

ev an: Revert PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/4530 — rolling back heuristic in canary only. Requesting one-review approval. Executing rollback now.

mohit: FastLane pinned to fallback variant — routing change deployed. Confirming reduced p99s in metrics (prelim): p99 dropped from 1.8s -> 0.5s on sample window.

lauren: Reviewed PR 4530 and approved. infra-bot shows rollback finished, canary -> previous routing.

jen (CS): Thanks. I updated FastLane with mitigation note and ETA for full remediation (8h). They're okay for now but asked for postmortem and SLA calc.

tev an: Follow-ups: lauren to open ticket for throttling circuit-breaker (owner = lauren). mohit to run a warmup-load test and share dashboard. jen to coordinate SLA computation with finance. I'll file the postmortem template.

mohit: Warmup test scheduled in 20m and I'll attach traces.

lauren: Ticket opened: ENG-10234 (throttling + e2e test). Writing acceptance criteria.

jen (CS): Marking this resolved for FastLane with the mitigation in place. We'll re-open if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

end of thread
